description: A React component for a modal dialog that allows editing properties of a dashboard, including metadata, styling, access, and other settings in the Superset frontend.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse
methods.description: Handles error responses from API calls, displaying appropriate danger toasts.

methods.name: handleDashboardData
methods.description: Processes dashboard data fetched from API and updates component state and form fields.

methods.name: fetchDashboardDetails
methods.description: Fetches dashboard details from API and initializes component state.

methods.name: getJsonMetadata
methods.description: Parses and returns the JSON metadata object from the jsonMetadata string.

methods.name: handleOnChangeOwners
methods.description: Updates owners state based on selection changes.

methods.name: handleOnChangeRoles
methods.description: Updates roles state based on selection changes.

methods.name: handleOnCancel
methods.description: Handles modal cancel action by calling onHide.

methods.name: onColorSchemeChange
methods.description: Updates the color scheme and associated metadata.

methods.name: onFinish
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates data, updates dashboard metadata, and makes API calls to save changes.

methods.name: handleChangeTags
methods.description: Updates tags state based on selection changes.
